about.title: About ChrystalClear
about.mission: ChrystalClear is free, open-source auto repair information built by and for technicians and DIYers.
about.free: All repair information is free forever: vehicle lookups, recalls, trouble codes, and every community-written guide and spec.
about.disclaimer: Information is provided by the community and public sources as-is, without warranty. Always confirm torque values and safety-critical specs against the manufacturer's service information before working on brakes, steering, suspension, airbags, fuel or high-voltage systems. You are responsible for your own work.
about.privacy: We collect the minimum: your email, display name and settings. No trackers. We never sell your data. You can download or delete your data at any time from the Account page.
about.license: Code: AGPL-3.0. Community content: CC BY-SA 4.0. Vehicle, recall and complaint data: NHTSA (public domain).
about.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with NHTSA, ALLDATA, Mitchell 1, Identifix or any vehicle manufacturer.

market.title: Parts marketplace
market.intro: Buy and sell new and used parts, matched to the vehicles they fit. Free to list — buyers and sellers arrange payment and pickup or shipping themselves.
market.searchPlaceholder: Part name, brand or part number
market.none: No listings match yet. Try fewer filters.
market.safetyTips: Stay safe: meet in a public place (many police stations offer safe-exchange spots), inspect parts before paying, check part numbers against your vehicle, and never send gift cards or wire money to strangers. Report anything that looks stolen or unsafe.
market.fitsAll: Universal — not tied to specific vehicles.
market.fitmentWarning: Fitment is the seller's information. Always confirm the part number against your vehicle before buying.
market.fitsAllHint: No vehicles added: the listing shows as a universal part. Add the vehicles it fits so buyers can find it.
market.fitsHint: Buyers who pick one of these vehicles will see your listing.
market.sourceVinHint: Helps buyers check fitment and shows it isn't stolen.
market.loginToMessage: Log in to message the seller
market.messageHint: Ask about fitment, condition or pickup. Don't share card numbers here.
market.reportThanks: Thanks — a moderator will look at it.
market.pendingNote: New sellers' first listings are checked by a moderator before they show up. This is usually quick.
market.removedNote: A moderator removed this listing. Reason: {{reason}}
market.becomeSellerIntro: Tell buyers who you are and roughly where you are. We only show your city and state — never your street address.
market.zipHint: Only you see your ZIP. It will help with distance search later.
market.verifyIntro: Licensed businesses get a ✓ Verified badge. It's required to sell used catalytic converters and new airbags. A moderator checks your license number on your state's public lookup. We don't store license documents.
market.listingTitleHint: What it is and what it fits, e.g. "Alternator 2015–2017 F-150 3.5L"
market.descriptionHint: Condition, what's included, any damage, why you're selling.

rules.title: Listing rules
rules.legal: I own this part legally. It is not stolen.
rules.noDefeat: No emissions "delete" or defeat parts (EGR/DPF/catalyst deletes, O2 simulators, test pipes) — they're illegal to sell under federal law.
rules.noSrs: No used or rebuilt airbags or SRS parts.
rules.cats: Catalytic converters: new ones must be EPA- or CARB-compliant; used ones only from verified licensed sellers.
rules.recall: No parts with an open, unrepaired safety recall.
rules.honest: No counterfeits. The description and photos are honest.
rules.accept: I agree to the listing rules
rules.srs: Airbags and SRS parts: new only, and only from verified businesses. Used or rebuilt airbags can't be listed.
rules.cat: Catalytic converters: new ones need EPA or CARB compliance (CARB needs the EO number). Used ones can only be sold by verified licensed sellers — many states require it.

mod.title: Marketplace review
mod.verifyHowTo: Look the license number up on the issuing state's public license lookup. Approve only if the business name and status match.
